title: microsorum linguiforme
intro: Microsorum linguiforme, commonly known as Tonga or Tonga Water Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum linguiforme include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional herbal remedies.
